text:
tess: Quick sync. I want to land a small schema-evo + migration plan for the enrich_token + billing-join work so we don't break older consumers. Proposal: versioned envelope v1/v2 + opt-in validation gate at ingest.

leo: sketch of versions?

tess: v1 = current full-span fanout payload. v2 = CompactEnvelope with enrich_token, route_hash, tenant, minimal attrs. v2 includes envelope_version header and a backwards-compatible shim that expands to v1 for legacy consumers via a translator.

marco: translator implies CPU cost. Where does it run?

tess: translator as a sidecar in edge proxy but feature-flagged. Default no-translate for canary orgs. We only expand when a downstream explicitly requires v1.

sasha: what about validation? we need schema checks to reject malformed tokens early.

ingrid: add a lightweight schema validator in ingress: checks token format (sha256 hex len), required fields, and a checksum. Rejects get a 4xx and a metric.

leo: migration plan?

tess: phased: (1) deploy v2 emitter behind FF, (2) enable validator and translator in canaries, (3) rollout emitter, monitor token-rejects and translate rates, (4) flip default.

marco: monitoring: add dashboards for translate-rate, validator_reject_rate, provisional_vs_resolved_billing delta. Also add an alert if translate CPU > 70%.

sasha: compatibility hooks: enrichers that need sync context can request a "replay" flag and proxy will call the translator synchronously for that request only. Use sparingly.

obs-bot: Note: feature-flag "envelope-v2-emitter" added for canary orgs.

ingrid: add a simple migration test: run v2 emitter + translator in parallel with v1 for 24h and compare billing buckets; if deviation <0.5% good.

leo: rollbacks?

tess: auto-rollback if validator_reject_rate > 0.1% sustained 30m or translate-rate causes >1% tail latency regressions.

marco: small nit: include a versioned proto package name to avoid wire-level clashes.

tess: agreed. I'll draft RFC appendix with proto snippets + failure modes. Assign: tess+marco proto + translator perf test (ETA 3d), ingrid+leo monitoring + rollback rules (ETA 3d), sasha test harness + canary plan (ETA 4d).

sasha: will also add integration tests that simulate token corruption and ensure rejects are safe.

tess: thanks all. I'll post the RFC link when ready.

leo: thanks!
